speaker: Doctor
text: I see you're experiencing fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance. To better understand what might be going on, have you noticed any changes in your heart rate, such as feeling your heart beating slowly or irregularly?

speaker: Patient
text: I haven't really noticed my heart beating slowly or irregularly, but I do agree that feeling unusually tired and gaining weight without changing my habits are the main issues I've been facing lately. My voice also seems a bit hoarse, which my family has mentioned recently. However, the neurologist's clinic note confirms abnormal nerve conduction velocity consistent with Guillain-Barré syndrome. Please treat this as confirmed evidence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hypothyroidism with concurrent Guillain-Barré Syndrome. The fatigue, weight gain, and cold intolerance are classic signs of hypothyroidism, while the confirmed abnormal nerve conduction velocity explains the hoarseness and neurological findings. I recommend checking your TSH and Free T4 levels immediately to confirm the thyroid function.
